title: GigaBrain-0.7: Scaling Embodied Foundation Models to Emergent Capabilities with a Three-System Architecture
task: Vision-language-action foundation model for multi-embodiment robot control
key_results: Achieves substantial improvements in zero-shot capabilities and task success rates across home and industrial scenarios on Maker H01 and mainstream robot embodiments; trained on 37,000+ hours of heterogeneous embodied data
comments: Three-system architecture (understanding, prediction, action) with one-stage alignment is a reasonable design choice, though concrete quantitative comparisons to prior work are not fully specified in the abstract.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Larger-scale heterogeneous pretraining and three-system architecture improve generalization across robot embodiments
hypotheses.result: Confirmed through improvements over GigaBrain-0 and π_0.5 baselines

title: Annotations as Rollouts: Efficient and Scalable Reinforcement Learning for Video MLLMs
task: Efficient RL post-training for video MLLMs
key_results: OraRL achieves 2.2x step time vs GRPO's 4.9x; Video-ORA-9B raises temporal mIoU from 62.5 to 66.0, tracking AO from 73.0 to 78.2, and scores 73.1 on VSI-Bench vs 55.0-55.1 for GPT-5/Gemini-3-Pro
comments: The advantage inversion problem is well-motivated, though the core contribution (oracle rollouts as optimization targets) is somewhat incremental.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Annotations can serve as oracle rollouts to improve sample efficiency beyond CoT generation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; OraRL matches GRPO with 2.2x fewer steps and no CoT required

title: WeMM-Embedding: WeChat Multi-Modal Embedding Technical Report
task: Universal multimodal embedding for text, image, video, and documents
key_results: 2B variant surpasses prior 8B open-source baseline on MMEB-v2; 9B achieves state-of-the-art score of 80.6; deployed at scale across WeChat applications
comments: Strong empirical results but limited methodological novelty; primarily an engineering contribution combining known techniques at scale.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Two-stage training (alignment + refinement) with knowledge transfer improves multimodal embeddings
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; achieves SOTA on MMEB-v2 and strong in-house benchmark performance

title: AutoSaddler: Automatic Harness Optimization with Durable Updates from Agent Execution Traces
task: Automatic harness optimization for LLM agents
key_results: Improves agent performance by 9.0pp on GAIA2, 9.6pp on SWE-Bench Pro, 10.0pp on Terminal-Bench 2.0
comments: Addresses real pain point in agent design; offline learning formulation is pragmatic though the improvements are modest.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Harness optimization benefits from deep debugging, targeted modifications, and generalization-aware selection
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via ablations; each component contributes measurably to improvements

title: On-Policy Self-Distillation in Diffusion Models
task: Reward-aligned diffusion model training via on-policy self-distillation
key_results: DiffusionOPSD achieves best scores in 19/20 reward-matched settings; outperforms competing methods by up to 44.0%; reduces GPU-hours by 40% on SD 3.5-M and 63% on Z-Image-Turbo
comments: Elegant formulation converting image rewards to intermediate supervision; the controlled experiments isolating target-construction vs realization gains provide good insights.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Larger target-construction gains translate to larger realized gains after fitting
hypotheses.result: Rejected; controlled experiments show no direct correlation

title: SecOPD: Mitigating Adaptive Prompt Injections by On-Policy Distillation
task: Defend LLM-based agents against adaptive prompt injection attacks
key_results: Qwen3.6-27B with SecOPD achieves 9.0% attack success rate vs 94.0% for prior SoTA Meta-SecAlign; generalizes to unseen domains with 4.7% ASR in tool-calling tasks
comments: Token-level feedback signal is a principled improvement over sequence-level approaches, though the method's computational overhead and scalability to larger models are not discussed.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Token-level feedback provides finer-grained training signals than sequence-level feedback (DPO/GRPO) for prompt injection defense
hypotheses.result: Confirmed by 85-point ASR reduction versus Meta-SecAlign

hypotheses.hypothesis: Security generalizes to unseen domains (tool-calling) via token-level approach
hypotheses.result: Confirmed with 4.7% ASR in agentic tool-calling tasks

title: CyberFactory: Scaling Cyber Security Capabilities with Instances from the Wild
task: Scalable cybersecurity agent training with real vulnerability data
key_results: Aegis reaches 52.4% Pass@1 on CyberGym (vs 29.6% base), +22.8pp over Qwen 3.5; outperforms general-purpose backbones under same scaffold
comments: Solid contribution connecting real CVE artifacts to executable task instances; the skill-guided procedure is domain-grounded but adds complexity.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Skill-guided agentic trajectories from real vulnerabilities improve cybersecurity capabilities
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; Aegis internalizes procedure without runtime skill dependency

title: Recursive Experiential-Working Memory Evolution for Long-Horizon Agent Harnesses
task: Recursive memory-evolution for long-horizon agent task execution
key_results: Recuris improves 35/37 model-benchmark pairs; +17.8pp on tau-bench (GPT-5.6), +15.6pp on Claude Opus 5; advantage widens to +32.2pp on longest tasks
comments: Strong results across diverse benchmarks; the recursive memory coupling is intuitive but the meta-agent mechanism for evidence-to-updates could be more formally specified.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Decoupling working memory (task progress) from experiential memory (skill history) improves long-horizon execution
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; gains increase with interaction horizon and failure patterns decrease by up to 80%

title: On-policy Distillation with Verifiable Reward
task: Combining on-policy distillation with verifiable rewards for reasoning tasks
key_results: OPDVR consistently outperforms standard OPD across six reasoning benchmarks; seamlessly integrates OPD and RLVR without hyperparameter tuning
comments: Clean integration of two paradigms via ReLU gating; the reformulation of implicit rewards is straightforward but the empirical gains are consistent.

hypotheses.hypothesis: ReLU gating on trajectory-conditioned rewards aligns dense distillation with task correctness without hyperparameter trade-offs
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; OPDVR improves over OPD on all six benchmarks tested

title: Best Practice Critic Optimization
task: Stable critic-based RL for language model alignment
key_results: BPCO matches or exceeds group-based baseline while sampling one response per prompt; consistent improvements across 1.5B to 30B models
comments: Careful ablation study of design choices is valuable; the bounded value predictions and Monte Carlo targets are relatively standard but the combination proves effective.

hypotheses.hypothesis: A carefully designed critic can reliably estimate advantages from one response, matching group-based methods
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; BPCO achieves parity with GRPO without response sampling

title: Game2World Engine: Unlocking In-the-Wild Gameplay Videos for World Model Training
task: Extracting world model training data from gameplay videos via UI removal
key_results: GameCleaner achieves 95.36 AAR on synthetic videos (+57.3% over temporal mask baseline), 80.05 on in-the-wild; world models trained on UI-free footage improve VideoReward by 6.83%
comments: Practical contribution addressing real data-cleaning bottleneck; the taxonomy and asset library are valuable artifacts but methodologically straightforward.

hypotheses.hypothesis: UI-free gameplay improves world model training compared to UI-overlaid footage
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 6.83% VideoReward improvement on cleaned data

title: From Seeing to Acting: Smart Glasses as First-Person Intelligence Platforms
task: First-person intelligence platform design for smart glasses
key_results: Comprehensive survey formalizing perception-state-interaction-action loop; introduces L0-L5 framework and nine-dimensional deployment evaluation
comments: Valuable systematization of fragmented literature, but limited to survey methodology; no novel technical contribution or empirical validation.

title: Meta^n: Recursive Self-Improvement through Emergent Depth
task: Recursive self-improvement through emergent meta-depth in LLM agents
key_results: Meta^n outperforms prior self-improving agents on all eight benchmark families; only method scoring above zero on ARC-AGI-2
comments: Clever recursive formulation avoiding meta-level instability; strong performance on ARC-AGI-2 suggests genuine capability improvement, though depth-conditioning analysis is limited.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Fixed meta-operation applied recursively to its own products enables unbounded depth without instability
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; Meta^n achieves ARC-AGI-2 success vs zero for prior methods

title: LAION-BVD: A 10-Million-Hour Open Video Dataset for Multimodal Pre-training
task: Large-scale open video dataset for multimodal pre-training
key_results: LAION-BVD contains 80M videos (10M hours) with competitive performance on video-text and audio-text benchmarks; synthetic captions and scene-aware extraction enable scaling
comments: Significant resource contribution but primarily a data-collection engineering effort; no novel methodology for caption generation or model training.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Synthetic captions enable scaling multimodal learning to 10M video hours
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; competitive performance with consistent improvements as scale increases

title: CAFE: Self-Improving Search Agents Need Co-Evolving Feedback
task: Co-evolving feedback mechanism for self-improving search agents
key_results: CAFE outperforms evaluated RL-based search agents on average; retains gains across six out-of-domain benchmarks; reduces hallucinations
comments: Elegant coupling of agent and critic roles; the shared-parameter design minimizes overhead but makes attribution of improvements less clear.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Co-evolving agent and critic policies outperforms improving either independently
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; alternating updates continue improving vs plateauing with single-component updates

title: AgentRoom: Concurrent Multi-Agent Coding in a CRDT-Backed Shared Workspace
task: Concurrent multi-agent coding via CRDT-backed shared workspace
key_results: AgentRoom with 2 agents reduces task abandonment versus solo agent baseline; coordination rather than parallelism drives performance; shown on Python DevBench and Rust+axum cross-language tasks
comments: The finding that coordination bears the load more than parallelism is valuable, but quantitative metrics (e.g., percentage improvement, absolute success rates) are vague in the abstract.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Coordination via CRDT-exposed MCP tools improves task completion over sequential or independent parallel agents
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; coordination load dominates over parallelism or CRDT-merge effects

title: Automata from Agent Traces: Failure and Next-Step Prediction
task: Predict LLM-agent failures and next steps via inferred finite-state machines
key_results: Compact FSMs (7-43 states) replay held-out data at ≥0.997 fitness; next-step prediction outperforms Agent Workflow Memory baselines; failure prediction achieves AUROC up to 0.94 with early-stopping capability
comments: FSM extraction from trace corpora is elegant and model-agnostic, though the generalization to truly novel agent behaviors or adversarial settings remains unclear.

model_io.model: FSM extractor (agent trace corpus → finite-state machine)

hypotheses.hypothesis: A single compact FSM captures the behavioral topology of LLM-agent traces across multiple runs
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; FSMs are compact and maintain near-identical topology across train/test splits

hypotheses.hypothesis: FSM-state context improves next-step and failure prediction over unstructured trace methods
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; FSM-context outperforms Agent Workflow Memory and achieves AUROC up to 0.94 for failure prediction

title: Length-Adaptive Decoding for Masked Diffusion Machine Translation
task: Length-adaptive decoding for masked diffusion machine translation
key_results: Entropy-Valley recovers 64.9% COMET-22 gain on En↔Zh, 65.3% on Zh→En, 33.0% on En→De; ties with autoregressive on En-Zh, leads on Zh-En without training
comments: Training-free approach is elegant; the insight that denoising-friendly lengths differ from reference lengths is useful, though gains vary substantially by language pair.

model_io.model: Masked diffusion language model for translation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Mean predictive entropy identifies denoising-friendly target lengths better than corpus statistics
hypotheses.result: Partially confirmed; 65.3% average gain but 33.0% on En→De suggests language-pair sensitivity

title: DREAM Technical Report
task: Agentic meta-control for industrial recommender system optimization
key_results: Re-ranking control improves IPV by 2.06%, Core IPV by 2.39%, GMV by 0.88%; extending to fine ranking raises to 2.71%, 3.06%, 1.31% respectively
comments: Well-executed industrial application with rigorous A/B testing; the Reward Dual Loop (offline simulation + online feedback) is pragmatic but not novel.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Policy-layer meta-control improves recommendation metrics without replacing existing pipelines
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; consistent gains on IPV, Core IPV, and GMV across A/B tests

title: When "Must" Becomes "Maybe": Constraint Weakening in LLM Agent Workflows
task: Preserving action-binding constraints in LLM agent workflow handoffs
key_results: Direct handoff preserves 100% of safety blockers; standard compression causes 100% constraint deactivation and 54.2% forbidden actions; restoring all state fields eliminates forbidden actions entirely
comments: Identifies a critical gap between semantic availability and operational constraint preservation in multi-stage LLM workflows—handoffs can lose binding force even when content is semantically present.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Compression-based handoff transformations weaken action-binding constraints despite retaining topical content
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: 100% constraint deactivation and 54.2% forbidden actions with standard compression

hypotheses.hypothesis: Restoring explicit state fields (prerequisite, authority, fallback, consequence) preserves operational constraints
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: full restoration achieves 100% preservation and 0% forbidden actions

hypotheses.hypothesis: Downstream verification can mitigate forbidden actions independently of artifact-level constraint preservation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: verification eliminates forbidden actions while artifact deactivation remains at 95.3%

title: MoTE: Mixture of Task Experts for Multi-Task Video Understanding
task: Multi-task video understanding with task-specific expert routing
key_results: VideoLLM-MoTE with five task experts achieves higher average top-1 accuracy than dense baseline while activating ~2B LLM parameters per sample; outperforms learned sparse-routing controls on COIN benchmarks
comments: Task-level routing is intuitive for procedural video tasks, but the marginal gains over dense all-expert activation baselines are not quantified in the abstract.

model_io.model: VideoLLM-MoTE (shared multimodal backbone + task-specific expert decoder)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Task-structured routing of LLM decoder experts improves efficiency and accuracy over dense and learned sparse-routing approaches
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; task-structured routing achieves higher accuracy with lower parameter activation than baselines

title: TorchMorph: CUDA-accelerated Morphological Transforms
task: GPU-accelerated morphological image transforms in PyTorch
key_results: Up to 1,100× throughput vs scipy.ndimage on greyscale morphology, 350× on distance transforms; 42× faster Sinkhorn solver; exact binary reproduction
comments: Solid engineering contribution; the fused CUDA kernels provide practical speedups but represent incremental infrastructure improvement rather than algorithmic innovation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: GPU-accelerated morphological operators enable integration into differentiable pipelines
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; direct operation on CUDA tensors without host round-trips

title: Autonomous Mathematical Discovery in an Open-World Multi-Agent Environment
task: Autonomous mathematical discovery via multi-agent collaboration in open-world environment
key_results: Discovered novel results on 5/12 AlphaEvolve problems including new infinite family of finite-field Kakeya sets and new kissing configurations in dimension 11; agents produced proofs and analyses alongside constructions
comments: This is a compelling demonstration of multi-agent emergent collaboration, though the role of human oversight and the generalizability to other discovery domains beyond combinatorics remain underspecified.

model_io.model: Multi-agent Station (collection of diverse LLM agents without central coordinator)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Decentralized multi-agent collaboration without scripted pipeline can autonomously discover novel mathematical results
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; obtained novel results on 5 AlphaEvolve problems and discovered new Ramsey number families

hypotheses.hypothesis: Agents can produce interpretable proofs and analyses alongside numerical constructions
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; agents generated theorems explaining constructions

title: Latent Action as Intention Enables Efficient Future Imagination for World Action Models
task: Efficient robot control via latent-action world models with future imagination
key_results: LAWA achieves 65.6% success (few-shot) and 80.8% (full data) on RoboCasa, +9.6pp and +4.5pp over Fast-WAM; 42.9% lower inference latency than Joint-WAM
comments: Good trade-off between efficiency and performance; the discrete tokenizer with action-free pre-training is a clean design choice.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Compact latent actions enable efficient test-time inference without sacrificing generalization
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; LAWA matches Joint-WAM performance with 42.9% latency reduction

title: Peptides display multilayered hydration shell substructures dictated by sequence-specific surface chemistry
task: Map submolecular-resolution hydration architecture of peptides using 3D AFM
key_results: Peptides organize water into multilayered hydration shell with gradient ordering modulated by sequence-specific surface chemistry; hydrophobic, polar, and charged residues create domains of enhanced and diminished water organization
comments: Direct real-space visualization of hydration structure at submolecular resolution is technically impressive, though the functional significance of observed water organization gradients for protein stability and recognition requires further experimental validation.

model_io.model: Self-assembled graphite-binding peptide arrays on graphite

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hydration architecture is sequence-dependent and modulated by surface chemistry
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: structured water exhibits gradient ordering dictated by hydrophobic, polar, and charged residues

title: State-dependent binding of the wedge domain controls inactivation of the mechanosensitive ion channel PIEZO1
task: Elucidate molecular mechanism of PIEZO1 inactivation via wedge domain state-dependent binding
key_results: Wedge deletion/disruption of π-π and cation-π interactions diminishes inactivation without affecting activation; MINFLUX shows wedge stabilizes flat inactivated conformation; wedge dissociation required for recovery
comments: State-dependent inactivation particle model is mechanistically elegant; however, the distinction between wedge stabilizing an inactivated conformation versus actively docking during inactivation could be further clarified with kinetic data.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Wedge domain acts as state-dependent inactivation particle docking to pore module
hypotheses.result: Supported: wedge deletion diminishes inactivation; MINFLUX shows wedge stabilizes flat inactivated state; dissociation required for recovery

hypotheses.hypothesis: Wedge interactions via π-π and cation-π bonds are critical for inactivation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: disruption of specific interactions reduces inactivation without impairing activation

title: Autoinhibition of untimely DNA binding by structural disorder in the full-length peroxisome proliferator-activated receptors (PPARs)
task: Characterize autoinhibition mechanism of DNA binding by disordered AB domain in PPARs
key_results: AB domain dynamically interacts with DBD to reduce DNA binding affinity; DNA binding (not ligand binding) releases AB domain to open state; autoinhibition present in PPAR-RXRα heterodimer but less pronounced
comments: Integrative structural modeling of full-length protein combined with NMR provides mechanistic insight, though cellular transactivation domain validation suggests potential functional complexity beyond autoinhibition.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Disordered AB domain prevents untimely DNA binding to PPAR monomers via dynamic interaction with DBD
hypotheses.result: Confirmed: AB domain autoinhibits DNA binding; released upon DNA binding to DBD

hypotheses.hypothesis: Ligand binding to LBD releases AB domain autoinhibition
hypotheses.result: Rejected: DNA binding (not ligand binding) triggers AB domain release

title: Characterizing dynamics of productive dynein stepping by MINFLUX
task: Resolve mechanochemical sequence of dynein stepping at submillisecond resolution
key_results: Dynein hydrolyzes one ATP per 8 nm step; stepping preceded by transient plus-end-directed 'dip' during microtubule release and head diffusion; slow ATP-hydrolyzing mutant exhibits increased dip frequency
comments: MINFLUX nanoscopy achieves unprecedented temporal resolution for motor protein dynamics; the dip-then-forward mechanism elegantly explains net directional movement despite diffusive intermediate.

hypotheses.hypothesis: ATP hydrolysis directly produces net forward movement in dynein stepping
hypotheses.result: Supported: slow ATP-hydrolyzing mutant shows more frequent dips, confirming ATP hydrolysis couples to forward bias

title: Automated prototyping of genetic codes
task: Automated prototyping of alternative genetic codes using non-standard tRNAs
key_results: Demonstrated aminoacylation of non-CCA-3′ tRNAs by all E. coli aaRSs; developed cell-free translation systems with compressed 34-codon genetic codes incorporating non-standard amino acids and reassigning up to three codons
comments: AGENTEX enables high-throughput screening of genetic code variants, but translation efficiency and fidelity of alternative codes in living cells remain to be demonstrated.

model_io.model: Cell-free translation system with altered ribosomal LSU
outputs: translated proteins with non-standard amino acids

hypotheses.hypothesis: tRNA 3′ CCA end is flexible enough to permit aminoacylation by natural aaRSs despite Watson–Crick LSU interactions
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; most non-CCA-3′ tRNAs are aminoacylated by E. coli aaRSs

hypotheses.hypothesis: Alternative genetic codes can be prototyped in cell-free systems with non-standard amino acid incorporation
hypotheses.result: Demonstrated with compressed 34-codon codes and up to three codon reassignments

title: Ultrafast and reference-free sequence discovery in single-cell data
task: Reference-free, ultrafast sequence discovery and interrogation across single-cell transcriptomics datasets
key_results: Malva Index comprises ~74 million cells enabling reference-free searching for arbitrary sequences, mutations, splice junctions, pathogens, and spatial transcript locations; demonstrates species-agnostic discovery without sequence references
comments: Malva scales transcriptomics beyond reference-dependent pipelines, but accuracy for novel splice variants and pathogen detection relative to gold standards requires validation.

model_io.model: Malva computational platform with neural network integration

hypotheses.hypothesis: Indexed raw sequence space enables reference-free cell type identification from sequence composition alone
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; Malva identifies cell types without gene count tables

hypotheses.hypothesis: Ultrafast search enables flexible downstream integration with neural networks for complex automated analyses
hypotheses.result: Demonstrated with state-of-the-art neural network connections for complex queries

title: Decitabine suppresses triple-negative breast cancer by disrupting DNMT1 liquid-liquid phase separation and synergizes with G9a inhibition
task: Demonstrate DNMT1 liquid-liquid phase separation disruption as therapeutic vulnerability in TNBC
key_results: DNMT1 forms LLPS condensates in TNBC; decitabine directly binds DNMT1 disordered domain and dissolves condensates; DAC+G9a inhibitor synergistically reduces metastasis
comments: LLPS-disruption as druggable cancer target is innovative; synergistic epigenetic combination therapy shows promising in vivo efficacy.

model_io.model: TNBC cell lines and murine/human TNBC xenografts

hypotheses.hypothesis: DNMT1 LLPS condensates drive TNBC progression and are druggable by DAC and G9a inhibitors
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; DAC+BIX combination significantly inhibits metastasis in murine and human TNBC models

title: G3BP1 depletion, observed in Parkinson’s Disease, drives Golgi–lysosome–autophagy defects
task: Reveal G3BP1-stabilized COPI vesicle protein axis in Golgi-lysosome-autophagy function
key_results: G3BP1 promotes beta-COP-USP10 interaction, preventing beta-COP ubiquitination and proteasomal degradation; G3BP1 depletion impairs Golgi/lysosomal function and autophagic clearance of α-synuclein
comments: Novel mechanistic connection between G3BP1 and vesicular trafficking; reduced G3BP1/beta-COP in PD and DLB brain tissues suggests pathological relevance.

model_io.model: Cultured cells and PD/DLB patient brain tissue and PD mouse model

hypotheses.hypothesis: G3BP1 depletion destabilizes beta-COP, impairing Golgi-lysosome-autophagy axis and α-synuclein clearance
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; G3BP1 and beta-COP co-depleted in PD/DLB patient tissue

title: TOPORS Deficiency Impairs TET2 SUMOylation leading to aberrant m5C Hypermethylation that promotes adipogenic differentiation of mesenchymal stem cells in osteoporosis
task: Elucidate TOPORS-mediated SUMOylation in MSC fate and bone-fat homeostasis
key_results: TOPORS deficiency promotes adipogenic differentiation; rAAV9-TOPORS overexpression improves trabecular bone and decreases marrow adiposity in OVX mice
comments: Mechanistic link between protein SUMOylation and RNA m5C modification is novel, though causality of m5C-FABP4 upregulation could be further validated with m5C-seq.

model_io.model: Human MSCs from osteoporosis patients and OVX/aged mice

hypotheses.hypothesis: TOPORS SUMOylates TET2 at K1055 to stabilize it and suppress adipogenic differentiation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; TOPORS deficiency reduces TET2 stability and increases FABP4 m5C

title: A bipartite glucan synthase-remodeler module organizes branched glucan assembly in the fungal cell wall
task: Identify Ghs2-Bgs3 glucan synthase-remodeler pairing for branched β-1,3-glucan assembly
key_results: Ghs2 (GH16 hydrolase) and Bgs3 (β-1,3-glucan synthase) physically associate and co-localize; both required for branched β-1,3-glucan accumulation with proper branching architecture
comments: Solid-state NMR and structure-guided modeling elegantly support the proposed linear synthesis followed by branch introduction mechanism.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Bgs3 synthesizes linear β-1,3-glucan and Ghs2 introduces β-1,6-branch points
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via NMR and genetic evidence; both enzymes required for proper branched polymer

title: Circadian temperature compensation is intrinsically linked with metabolism and redox signaling
task: Establish mechanistic link between circadian temperature compensation and metabolism-redox signaling
key_results: Intracellular redox sensing of metabolic rate is intrinsic to temperature compensation; mechanism conserved in bacterial and mammalian cells
comments: Fundamental discovery resolving long-standing question of circadian temperature compensation; metabolic-redox coupling adds parsimony to biological timekeeping.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Redox sensing of metabolism intrinsically compensates for temperature effects on circadian period
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; redox-metabolism linkage preserves constant period across temperature range

title: Dual apical methyltransferases orchestrate motility initiation in apicomplexan parasites
task: Characterize dual methyltransferase orchestration of apicomplexan motility initiation
key_results: TgPCKMT anchors TgFRM1 at conoid for F-actin assembly; TgAKMT acts downstream to promote TgGAC-dependent force transmission; TgPCKMT depletion prevents TgAKMT translocation
comments: Elegant two-step methylation-actin coupling mechanism; lysine methylation as a central regulatory axis for parasite motility is conceptually novel.

model_io.model: Toxoplasma gondii apical apparatus and glideosome

hypotheses.hypothesis: Sequential methylation by TgPCKMT and TgAKMT couples actin nucleation with force propagation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; TgPCKMT depletion blocks TgAKMT translocation and abrogates motility

title: A redox switch on CDC48 regulates peroxisomal function via controlling peroxisome-associated protein degradation
task: Elucidate H2O2-redox sensing mechanism of CDC48-NPL4-UFD1 complex in peroxisomal degradation
key_results: H2O2-triggered CDC48 Cys271 oxidation represses ATPase activity and stabilizes PEX22; CDC48-C271S variant shows accelerated PEX22 turnover and oxidative stress susceptibility
comments: Elegant identification of CDC48 as an H2O2 sensor integrating redox state with proteostasis; NRX1-mediated reduction mechanism adds mechanistic depth.

hypotheses.hypothesis: H2O2 oxidizes CDC48-Cys271 to inhibit ATPase and stabilize PEX22, modulating peroxisomal function
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; redox-insensitive C271S variant loses H2O2-sensing capacity and increases oxidative stress susceptibility

title: Decreased expression of SOX2 and SOX2-OT in oligozoospermia: Correlations with spermogram parameters
task: Investigate SOX2-OT and SOX2 downregulation in oligozoospermia etiology
key_results: SOX2-OT and SOX2 significantly downregulated in oligozoospermic samples; SOX2-OT positively correlates with sperm count, concentration, and motility
comments: Correlative study establishing association but lacking functional validation; causal role of lncRNA in spermatogenesis impairment remains to be demonstrated.

model_io.model: Semen-derived cell pellets from oligozoospermic and normozoospermic men

hypotheses.hypothesis: SOX2-OT downregulation contributes to impaired spermatogenesis
hypotheses.result: Observed inverse correlation between SOX2-OT and testosterone; positive correlation with sperm parameters

title: Activation of angiogenic gene expression following intradermal delivery of HIF-1α mRNA in rat dermal tissue
task: Evaluate intradermal HIF-1α mRNA delivery for activation of angiogenic pathways
key_results: HIF-1α mRNA transfection significantly elevated HIF-1α expression at 24h; canonical targets VEGF, ANGPT1, PGF upregulated (p < 0.05)
comments: Proof-of-concept study in rat skin demonstrates functional delivery and transcriptional activation; in vivo flap viability outcomes not reported here.

model_io.model: Rat dorsal dermal tissue injected with lipid nanoparticle-HIF-1α mRNA

hypotheses.hypothesis: HIF-1α mRNA delivery activates downstream angiogenic gene transcription
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; VEGF, ANGPT1, PGF significantly upregulated 24h post-transfection

title: Health promoting spirulina platensis nanoparticles induce early embryonic loss in heat-stressed rabbit does
task: Assess spirulina nanoparticle supplementation effects on heat-stressed rabbit reproductive performance
key_results: Spirulina nanoparticles mitigate heat stress effects, improve antioxidant capacity and oocyte numbers; however, immunomodulation causes inadequate placental spiral artery development and increased early embryonic loss
comments: Cautionary finding; despite beneficial antioxidant effects, immunomodulatory nanoparticle effects paradoxically impair embryo survival, suggesting need for targeted immunological assessment.

model_io.model: Heat-stressed New Zealand White rabbit does

hypotheses.hypothesis: Spirulina nanoparticles alleviate heat stress oxidative damage and improve reproduction
hypotheses.result: Partially confirmed; improved general health and oocytes, but immunomodulatory effects increased early embryonic loss

title: UQCRH promoter methylation limits apoptosis and drug sensitivity in ovarian cancer cells
task: Determine UQCRH promoter methylation contribution to apoptotic resistance in ovarian cancer
key_results: UQCRH downregulated in ovarian cancer and inversely correlated with promoter hypermethylation; demethylating agent restores UQCRH and enhances cisplatin-induced apoptosis
comments: Clear epigenetic mechanism linking DNA methylation to chemoresistance; therapeutic potential warrants evaluation in preclinical models.

model_io.model: Ovarian cancer cell lines and patient specimens

hypotheses.hypothesis: UQCRH promoter hypermethylation silences expression and impairs apoptosis
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; demethylation restores UQCRH and sensitizes cells to cisplatin-induced apoptosis

title: Myosin-10 promotes angiogenesis and malignant phenotypes in thyroid cancer through functional association with the FGF/FGFR1 signaling axis
task: Clarify MYH10-FGF/FGFR1 functional association in thyroid cancer angiogenesis
key_results: MYH10 knockdown inhibits K1 cell proliferation/invasion and HUVECs tube formation; MYH10 downregulates FGF3/FGFR1 expression
comments: CoIP-MS identified FGFR1 association with only 1 unique peptide (0.68% coverage), and no rescue experiments performed, limiting mechanistic certainty of direct pathway dependency.

model_io.model: K1 papillary thyroid carcinoma cells and HUVECs

hypotheses.hypothesis: MYH10 promotes thyroid cancer angiogenesis through FGF/FGFR1 axis
hypotheses.result: MYH10 knockdown suppresses FGF3/FGFR1 and reduces angiogenic markers, but direct binding not definitively proven

title: Disruption of de novo fatty acid biosynthesis rewires cellular lipid metabolism toward mTOR-associated compensatory fatty acid uptake
task: Characterize mTOR-mediated compensatory fatty acid uptake upon ACC1 disruption in T cells
key_results: ACC1 disruption reduces lipid droplets but increases fatty acid uptake via CD36/SLC27A4 upregulation; mTOR inhibition suppresses this compensatory uptake
comments: Multi-omics integration reveals lipid metabolic plasticity in T cells; therapeutic potential in targeting mTOR-driven compensatory pathways.

model_io.model: EL4 T cells with ACC1 disruption

hypotheses.hypothesis: Impaired fatty acid biosynthesis triggers mTOR-dependent compensatory fatty acid uptake
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; mTOR inhibition blocks CD36/SLC27A4 upregulation and reduces fatty acid uptake in ACC1-deficient cells

title: Oscillator-based Ising machine applied for Max-Cut in massively large and sparse graphs
task: Solve large-scale Max-Cut combinatorial optimization via GPU-based oscillator Ising machine
key_results: Solved Max-Cut up to 20 million spins in sparse graphs (degree 25); accuracy >99.5% (up to 99.9%); scalable to multi-GPU via annealing with dynamical checkpoints
comments: GPU-native OIM implementation demonstrates practical scalability advantage; accuracy comparable to or better than Goemans-Williamson, though benchmark on specific hard instances would strengthen claims.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Dynamical checkpoints as bifurcation points enable fast local search in Max-Cut
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; annealing strategy achieves >99.5% average accuracy

title: Soliton extraction and geometric analysis for the Hamiltonian amplitude equation
task: Analyze soliton solutions and symmetries of the Hamiltonian amplitude equation
key_results: Conservation laws verified numerically with relative errors <10^-6 over long propagation; multiple exact soliton families (dark, singular, bright-dark, mixed) derived via rational extended sinh-Gordon expansion
comments: Comprehensive integration of Lie symmetry, Hamiltonian-Poisson formulation, and numerical verification provides solid theoretical foundation, though physical motivation for the equation could be clearer.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Conservation laws remain invariant under soliton dynamics
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; numerical errors remain below 10^-6 over long intervals

hypotheses.hypothesis: Lie symmetries generate conserved flows via Hamiltonian-Poisson structure
hypotheses.result: Confirmed through explicit construction of Poisson bracket relationships

title: Comparative machine-learning modelling of effective thermal conductivity in nano-enhanced phase change materials
task: Predict thermal conductivity enhancement in nano-enhanced phase change materials using machine learning
key_results: Gradient boosting and random forest R² = 0.46 ± 0.56 and 0.43 ± 0.70; best RMSE = 0.17, best MAE = 0.10; operationally synergy index 0.65-2.0; leave-one-source-out R² ≈ 0.05
comments: Moderate cross-validation performance reflects data scarcity and heterogeneity; poor transfer-learning capability highlights need for larger, unified datasets before practical deployment.

inputs: filler type, loading, intrinsic conductivity, base material

model_io.model: Ensemble ML models (gradient boosting, random forest, SVR, NN, linear regression)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Gradient boosting and random forest outperform SVR and neural networks on this dataset
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; GB and RF achieved highest R² with lower overfitting

hypotheses.hypothesis: Loading and filler intrinsic conductivity dominate feature importance
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via model inspection

title: Advancing GaN detectors toward proton therapy applications
task: Demonstrate GaN diode arrays for proton therapy beam imaging and monitoring
key_results: Linear response across three orders of magnitude; beam position uncertainty ±0.07 mm, linewidth uncertainty ±0.14 mm; robustness up to 100 kGy irradiation; sensitivity down to 10 pA
comments: Proof-of-concept establishes GaN as practical radiation-hard detector material, though scaling to 2D matrices and clinical deployment remain future work.

hypotheses.hypothesis: GaN maintains intrinsic radiation hardness under clinical proton beam irradiation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; device remains functional at 100 kGy with high sensitivity

title: Assessing gamma-ray shielding effectiveness in alloy europium-modified Zintl-phase
task: Assess gamma-ray shielding effectiveness in europium-modified Zintl-phase alloy
key_results: CEZS4 achieved mass attenuation coefficient 0.0977 cm²/g at 0.511 MeV; 27-65% enhancement in linear attenuation vs. Eu-free reference; 22-40% reduction in half/tenth-value layers; effective atomic number increased from ~35 to ~54 in K-edge window
comments: Comprehensive Geant4/Phy-X validation and comparative analysis establish CEZS4 as competitive with metallic alloys, though brittleness and manufacturability of Zintl phases may limit practical adoption.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Europium doping enhances gamma-ray shielding via increased effective atomic number
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; CEZS4 shows 27-65% enhancement across full energy range

title: Solvatochromic behavior of lawsone investigated through experimental and DFT computational studies
task: Characterize solvatochromic behavior and photophysical properties of lawsone
key_results: Stokes shift varies from 2.528 eV (cyclohexane) to 3.118 eV (ethanol); HOMO-LUMO gap decreases from 6.503 eV (n-hexane) to 6.40 eV (water); dipole moment reduces from 4.734 D (ground state) to 4.359 D (excited state) in water
comments: Comprehensive experimental-computational agreement validates solvent polarity effects, confirming negative solvatochromism through competition between dielectric and hydrogen-bonding interactions.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Lawsone exhibits bathochromic shift with increasing solvent polarity
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; significant emission shift and Stokes shift variation observed

hypotheses.hypothesis: Negative solvatochromism arises from dipole moment reduction upon excitation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed through DFT calculations showing 0.375 D decrease in water

title: Wannier functions from non-bloch bands of 1D non-Hermitian photonic systems
task: Formulate Wannier functions for 1D non-Hermitian photonic systems using non-Bloch theory
key_results: Biorthogonal Wannier density is gauge-invariant and numerically stable; shows robust exponential localization linked to non-Bloch winding number; individual left/right WFs are gauge-dependent with artificial spatial shifts
comments: Novel identification of gauge-invariant biorthogonal Wannier density provides practical computational tool, though physical interpretation in open-boundary photonics requires further experimental validation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Individual left/right Wannier functions are gauge-dependent but biorthogonal density is gauge-invariant
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; density invariant under smooth biorthogonal gauge-fixing

hypotheses.hypothesis: Wannier density localization correlates with non-Bloch winding number
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; robust exponential localization observed in complex OBC spectra

title: Harnessing structural disorder: unraveling hydrogen evolution in monolayer amorphous carbon via first-principles simulations and machine-learned potentials
task: Investigate hydrogen evolution reaction in monolayer amorphous carbon via DFT and machine-learned potentials
key_results: MAC exhibits ΔGH range -0.02 to +1.35 eV (DFT), -0.91 to +1.70 eV (MLIP); ~15% sites below +0.25 eV threshold; 7-membered rings, bond distortion, and ripples enhance HER; MLIP achieves 95% active-site classification accuracy
comments: MACE MLIP enables efficient full-surface screening of amorphous structures; combination of DFT validation and structural feature analysis provides mechanistic insight for rational design.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Structural disorder in amorphous carbon creates diverse HER active sites with favorable ΔGH
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; ~15% of sites achieve ΔGH <+0.25 eV, comparable to noble metals

hypotheses.hypothesis: MLIP trained on DFT achieves reliable ΔGH prediction and site classification
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 0.161 eV MAE in ΔGH and 95% classification accuracy on independent samples

title: Developmental and MAPK-responsive transcription factors regulate distinct malignant cell states and associated genetic dependencies in pancreatic cancer
task: Characterize molecularly distinct cell states and their regulatory mechanisms in pancreatic cancer
key_results: Single-cell MR analysis identified three developmental lineage states with six epigenetically distinct substates stratified by MAPK activity; barcode-based lineage tracing confirmed spontaneous and treatment-dependent plasticity; state-specific MR essentiality validated through loss-of-function studies.
comments: The integration of single-cell analysis with functional validation and spatial characterization provides mechanistic insight, though the therapeutic targetability of plastic states remains to be demonstrated clinically.

model_io.model: single-cell master regulator analysis with functional validation

hypotheses.hypothesis: PDA malignant cells exist in distinct developmental lineage states regulated by lineage-specific MRs
hypotheses.result: Three co-existing developmental states identified with distinct MR signatures and morphologies

hypotheses.hypothesis: MRs are essential and sufficient to determine cell state
hypotheses.result: Loss-of-function and ectopic expression studies confirmed state-specific MR essentiality and reprogramming capacity

hypotheses.hypothesis: Cells exhibit plastic transitions between states in response to treatment
hypotheses.result: Barcode-based lineage tracing confirmed both spontaneous and treatment-dependent cross-state plasticity
